name: windstack-sdk

scripts.build:native: tsc -b packages/crypto packages/abi packages/rpc packages/contract packages/account packages/antelope packages/session
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/evm packages/solana packages/crypto packages/abi packages/rpc packages/contract packages/account packages/antelope packages/vexanium packages/wallet-plugin-wisp packages/session
scripts.test: node scripts/test-signing.mjs && node scripts/test-provider-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-provider-spec.mjs && node scripts/test-sdk-behavior.mjs && node scripts/test-native-antelope.mjs
scripts.validate:native: npm run clean && npm run build:native && npm run test:native && npm run pack:native
scripts.validate: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test && npm run pack:dry-run
scripts.release:npm: npm publish -w @windstack/crypto --access public && npm publish -w @windstack/abi --access public && npm publish -w @windstack/rpc --access public && npm publish -w @windstack/contract --access public && npm publish -w @windstack/account --access public && npm publish -w @windstack/antelope --access public && npm publish -w @windstack/session --access public

author: Gilang Ramadan
description: Modern TypeScript SDK packages for WindStack, Wisp Wallet, Vexanium and Antelope applications.
